charts.title: TOI-969 b: orbits around TOI-969
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-969's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-969 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Lillo-Box et al. 2023 (2023A&A...669A.109L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LILLO_BOX_ET_AL_2023): P 1.8237305 d

charts.title: TOI-969 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-969 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (34) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 280437559, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 6-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 6-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
